name: mojulo-work
description: Build, edit and export deterministic 3D artifacts with Mojulo running locally in supported ChatGPT Work and Codex execution environments.

interface.longDescription: Build, edit and export deterministic 3D objects, scenes, worlds and games with Mojulo running locally in supported ChatGPT Work and Codex execution environments. Mojulo keeps procedural recipes and refs in the active workspace so existing artifacts can be edited in place and portable state can be used for continuation. Requires Node.js 22.14+ and npm access. This skills-only plugin does not require or send geometry to a hosted Mojulo execution service.
